item.text:
**8B.3 Research Note: Joko Widodo, 2024**

Bottom line: **yes, but unevenly and often through patronage.** Jokowi clearly mobilized party, cabinet, bureaucracy, and election-adjacent state tools toward both his development program and his post-presidency influence goals. The record also shows friction, backlash, and incomplete control, so “effective” is only partly true.

**Accepted claims**
- **Indonesia’s Golkar party picks influential Jokowi’s top loyalist as leader** | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-08-21 | https://theprint.in/world/indonesias-golkar-party-picks-influential-jokowis-top-loyalist-as-leader/2231679/  
  - Claim: Golkar installed a Jokowi loyalist as party chief, and Reuters reported this could help Jokowi retain political influence after leaving office. That is direct evidence of network/party mobilization for his own goals.  
  - IDs: 8B.3, 8B.1

- **Indonesia’s outgoing leader gives cabinet jobs to loyalists of successor Prabowo** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-08-19 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/outgoing-indonesian-president-widodo-names-prabowo-aides-to-cabinet-3576652  
  - Claim: Jokowi used a late-term reshuffle to place people close to Prabowo into cabinet roles, framed as smoothing the transition. This shows active coalition management and use of state appointments for political ends.  
  - IDs: 8B.3, 8B.2

- **Indonesia president says cabinet working normally, amid reports of discontent** | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-02-01 | https://theprint.in/world/indonesias-jokowi-insists-no-problem-in-cabinet-amid-rumbles-of-discontent/1950219/  
  - Claim: Even amid cabinet discontent and speculation about Sri Mulyani’s resignation, Jokowi said the cabinet was working normally. That is limited evidence of bureaucratic continuity under political stress.  
  - IDs: 8B.3, 8B.2

- **President Jokowi, Defense Minister Prabowo Review Nusantara’s Development Progress** | Sekretariat Kabinet Republik Indonesia | 2024-08-12 | https://setkab.go.id/en/president-jokowi-defense-minister-prabowo-review-nusantaras-development-progress/  
  - Claim: Jokowi personally inspected Nusantara’s construction with Prabowo and publicly described the project as progressing as expected. This is strong evidence of top-level mobilization around the flagship capital project.  
  - IDs: 8B.3, 8B.1, 8B.2

- **Pidato Kenegaraan pada Sidang Tahunan MPR RI, Presiden Sampaikan Capaian 10 Tahun Pembangunan Indonesia** | Sekretariat Negara | 2024-08-16 | https://www.setneg.go.id/baca/index/pidato_kenegaraan_pada_sidang_tahunan_mpr_ri_presiden_sampaikan_capaian_10_tahun_pembangunan_indonesia  
  - Claim: Jokowi used his annual state address to frame the last decade around concrete development achievements and a vision for a more prosperous and equal Indonesia. That shows coordinated elite messaging behind the program.  
  - IDs: 8B.3, 8B.1

- **Bawaslu and Kominfo task force on hoax-free election** | Freedom House, *Freedom on the Net 2024 - Indonesia* | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/indonesia/freedom-net/2024  
  - Claim: Ahead of the 2024 election, Bawaslu formed a monitoring task force with KPU, Kominfo, and police cyber units to monitor social media and order takedowns. That is direct evidence of state apparatus mobilization for electoral information control, even if it was coercive and overbroad.  
  - IDs: 8B.3, 4B.6, 4B.2

- **Protests across Indonesia as parliament delays change to election law** | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-08-22 | https://theprint.in/world/protests-across-indonesia-as-parliament-delays-change-to-election-law/2233305/  
  - Claim: Allies tried to change election rules in ways widely seen as strengthening Jokowi’s influence and helping his youngest son, but protests forced a delay. This is evidence of attempted network mobilization for family advantage, but also of limited effectiveness and backlash.  
  - IDs: 8B.3, 4B.2, 7B.9

**Search gap**
- I did not find a single internal budget memo, cabinet directive, or full implementation dashboard that directly proves overall coordination quality. The judgment here is therefore inferential, built from public appointments, official events, coalition moves, and reported institutional behavior.
